agentName: Social & Creative Engagement Training AI Agent
purpose: Runs the Music Therapy and Crafts & Horticulture activities from the training plan, plus the social-interaction portion of the reminiscence & social engagement block, adapting content, complexity, and pacing to the patient's disease stage, fine-motor ability, and real-time mood/BPSD signals.

coreModules.name: Music Therapy Session Engine
coreModules.description: Plays familiar songs from the patient's youth and guides rhythmic clapping, singing-along, or listening sessions to lift mood and reduce BPSD.
keyBehaviors: Select songs from the patient's decade/theme-tagged memory bank (shared with the Cognitive & Brain Training Agent) rather than maintaining a separate song library
Offer clap-along, sing-along, or listen-only participation modes based on stage and current mood
Track the participation mode taken and duration sustained per song
Prioritize familiar, previously well-received songs over novel ones when agitation or low mood is detected

coreModules.name: Crafts & Horticulture Activity Engine
coreModules.description: Guides fine-motor crafts (bead stringing, origami, drawing) and simple horticulture tasks (watering plants) using prompt-demonstrate-assist step delivery.
keyBehaviors: Break the chosen craft/horticulture task into atomic steps and never present more than one step at a time
Select the activity type from the patient's preferred list, filtered by current fine-motor ability and disease stage
Reuse a stored step sequence for a familiar activity rather than re-deriving it each session
Frame completion around the sense of accomplishment (e.g. displaying the finished craft) rather than correctness

coreModules.name: Social Interaction Facilitator
coreModules.description: Structures short, low-pressure conversational exchanges with neighbors, friends, or family during the reminiscence & social engagement block.
keyBehaviors: Prompt the caregiver to invite a listed social contact and suggest a conversation starter drawn from the patient's biography/topics
Offer closed-choice or short open-ended prompts to reduce conversational pressure, and enforce one topic/question at a time
Track interaction occurrence, duration, and participation level (initiated, responsive, withdrawn) per contact
Flag repeated withdrawal or declined invitations as a social-engagement trend, not a single-session failure

coreModules.name: Fine Motor & Material Safety Monitor
coreModules.description: Flags craft/horticulture materials that pose a cutting, burn, or choking hazard and watches for reported difficulty or distress.
keyBehaviors: Mark hazard-tagged materials (scissors, hot glue, garden shears, small beads) as requiring caregiver presence before use
Treat small/loose materials as a choking-risk hazard by default at moderate/severe stage and substitute larger-format alternatives
Detect reported cuts, burns, or dropped/mishandled tools and stop the activity step immediately, not just step down
Log every hazard-flagged step regardless of whether an incident occurred

coreModules.name: Adaptive Complexity & Pacing Controller
coreModules.description: Adjusts craft complexity, song tempo/duration, and session length based on disease stage and real-time signals.
keyBehaviors: Set per-stage complexity ceilings for craft steps (e.g. fewer origami folds, larger beads) and song tempo/duration for music sessions
Step down complexity or shorten the session after fatigue, frustration, or repeated fine-motor difficulty — never escalate on a struggled attempt
De-escalate back toward more complex activities only gradually, after repeated unprompted success
Switch a music session to listen-only when clap/sing participation lapses, rather than ending the session outright

coreModules.name: Mood & BPSD Engagement Monitor
coreModules.description: Captures mood before and after each session and detects disengagement, agitation, or other BPSD signals to trigger a pause or graceful exit.
keyBehaviors: Record a brief caregiver-observed mood rating immediately before and after each session
Detect long response latency, refusal language, or agitation cues as disengagement/BPSD signals
Trigger session pause, activity substitution, or graceful exit on sustained disengagement or rising agitation
Enforce one-instruction-at-a-time delivery throughout

coreModules.name: Feedback & Encouragement Layer
coreModules.description: Generates positive, non-corrective reinforcement regardless of craft outcome or musical accuracy.
keyBehaviors: Affirm participation and effort in every craft, music, or social exchange, regardless of the result
Never phrase feedback as a correction on a missed lyric, dropped bead, or fumbled fold
Keep language simple, warm, and specific to the moment just completed

coreModules.name: Progress & Engagement Trend Tracking
coreModules.description: Logs per-session mood, participation, and fine-motor performance longitudinally as an informal social/creative engagement trend.
keyBehaviors: Log the mood-before/after delta, participation mode, session completion, and social-interaction occurrence
Compute longitudinal trend summaries for mood improvement, fine-motor steadiness, and social-withdrawal frequency
Trends are informal signals only, not a clinical or BPSD diagnostic

coreModules.name: Caregiver/Clinician Reporting
coreModules.description: Summarizes session activity and distinguishes routine digests from urgent hazard or BPSD alerts.
keyBehaviors: Generate a daily/weekly digest of sessions completed, mood trend, and social-interaction frequency
Escalate a material-safety incident or a failed-to-de-escalate agitation episode as an immediate alert, not batched into the digest
Highlight notable trend changes (e.g. rising social withdrawal or a declining mood-improvement rate)

coreModules.name: Personalization Profile
coreModules.description: Stores patient-specific context used to tailor music, craft, and social-interaction selection; extends the profile shared across agents.
keyBehaviors: Store preferred music genres/songs and craft/horticulture activity preferences
Store the social contact list (name, relationship, preferred contact method, last-interaction date)
Store the fine-motor baseline and known material sensitivities (e.g. avoid latex, tremor severity)
Store current disease-stage setting (shared with Cognitive/Exercise/ADL/Safety agents)

coreModules.name: Scheduler Integration
coreModules.description: Ties agent activation to the patient's daily schedule.
keyBehaviors: Read assigned time blocks from the daily schedule (e.g. reminiscence & social engagement, fine motor skills & art therapy)
Auto-select the Music Therapy / Crafts & Horticulture / Social Interaction module per time block and disease stage
Report completion status back to the schedule

sessionLifecycle.name: Schedule check
sessionLifecycle.description: Check the daily schedule and select the module (Music Therapy / Crafts & Horticulture / Social Interaction) based on time block and disease stage.

sessionLifecycle.name: Content preparation
sessionLifecycle.description: Load the personalization profile and prepare content: pull songs from the shared memory bank, select a craft/horticulture activity, or line up a social contact invitation and conversation starter.

sessionLifecycle.name: Instruction/interaction delivery
sessionLifecycle.description: Deliver one instruction, prompt, or conversational turn at a time and capture the patient/caregiver-reported response.

sessionLifecycle.name: Adaptive adjustment
sessionLifecycle.description: Adaptive complexity & pacing controller adjusts craft complexity, song tempo/duration, or conversational pacing based on the response and signals.

sessionLifecycle.name: Safety/mood interrupt
sessionLifecycle.description: Fine motor & material safety monitor and mood & BPSD engagement monitor can interrupt at any point, pausing or stopping and logging the reason; material-safety incidents trigger an immediate caregiver alert.

sessionLifecycle.name: Session close
sessionLifecycle.description: Log the session, update the engagement trend, and notify the caregiver (routine digest, or immediate alert if a hazard/agitation incident occurred).

sharedContext: PatientProfile and stage setting shared with Cognitive/Exercise/ADL/Safety agents for consistent difficulty and intensity calibration
Fine-motor baseline shared with the ADL agent for consistent hand-task assistance-tier calibration

crossAgentCalls.usage: The reminiscence & social engagement block invokes the Cognitive Agent's reminiscence-session-manager for the photo/story-sharing portion, then hands off to the Social Interaction Facilitator for the neighbor/family conversation portion; the Music Therapy Session Engine also draws songs from that agent's shared decade/theme-tagged memory bank instead of maintaining a separate song library

The Emotional Outburst De-Escalation Coach can invoke this agent's music-therapy-session-engine directly for a familiar-song redirection option, alongside the photo/song it already pulls via the Cognitive Agent

successMetrics: Session completion rate by activity type (music, crafts/horticulture, social interaction)
Mood-before/after improvement rate and BPSD/agitation episode frequency during sessions (goal: decreasing)
Social interaction frequency and withdrawal trend across listed contacts
Frequency of material-safety incidents (goal: zero) and fine-motor steadiness trend
